messages.content: The system has been implemented according to the architectural specification. All TypeScript interfaces and types are precisely implemented. Each service, the event bus, and the router are in their own files, managing their own in-memory data stores. Services communicate primarily through the event bus, with cross-service data needs for event payloads handled via dependency injection of service interfaces in constructors to adhere to the `NO_CROSS_SERVICE_IMPORTS` rule. The `TaskService` enforces the `FORWARD_ONLY_STATUS` rule. HTTP handling is confined to the `router.ts`. The project exclusively uses Node.js built-in modules. A `main.ts` wires everything together and starts the server, and a `demo.ts` script exercises all features end-to-end. The project compiles cleanly with `npx tsc --noEmit`.

input.summary: Implemented a Task Management API in TypeScript adhering to all architectural specifications. Includes services, event bus, router, main entry point, and a demo script. All code compiles cleanly.
